items.title: Awesome Arcgis Developers
items.content_text:
### APIs and SDKs

*   Integrations & Plugins (third-party libraries):
    *   [ArcGIS integrations with CesiumJS](https://developers.arcgis.com/cesiumjs/) - Guide and tutorials to help you start build mapping applications with CesiumJS and ArcGIS.
    *   [ArcGIS integrations with MapLibre GL JS](https://developers.arcgis.com/maplibre-gl-js/maplibre-arcgis-plugin/) - Learn how to connect MapLibre GL JS apps with ArcGIS services using the Esri-maintained ArcGIS MapLibre plugin and ArcGIS REST JS, including tutorials, API references, and sample code.
    *   [ArcGIS integrations with OpenLayers](https://developers.arcgis.com/openlayers/) - Guide and tutorials to help you start building web apps with OpenLayers and ArcGIS location services.
    *   [ArcGIS integrations with Leaflet](https://developers.arcgis.com/esri-leaflet/) - Learn how to connect Leaflet apps with ArcGIS services using the Esri-maintained Esri Leaflet plugin and ArcGIS REST JS, including tutorials, API references, and sample code.
    *   [Esri-gl (⭐7)](https://github.com/muimsd/esri-gl) - A community-maintained plugin that enables the use of ArcGIS services in Mapbox GL JS and MapLibre GL JS applications.
items.content_html:

### Projects / API Management

*   [Gravitee.io API Management (⭐327) (⭐324)](https://github.com/gravitee-io/gravitee-api-management) - A lightweight, open-source platform offering flexible API governance, robust security, and straightforward configuration.

### Projects / API Design

*   [JSLT (⭐677) (⭐676)](https://github.com/schibsted/jslt) - Powerful JSON query and transformation language inspired by jq and XPath, designed for rapid and flexible data manipulation.

*   [LavinMQ (⭐799) (⭐796)](https://github.com/cloudamqp/lavinmq) - High-performance message queue server implementing AMQP 0-9-1 and MQTT protocols, built with Crystal for exceptional throughput and minimal resource usage.

*   [n8n (⭐150k) (⭐146k)](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n) - Open-source workflow automation tool with 400+ connectors, giving you full control over your data and integrations.

*   [YAML (⭐416) (⭐414)](https://github.com/yaml/yaml-spec) - A human-friendly and easy-to-read data serialization format that is widely used for configuration files and data exchange. It supports rich data types and is compatible with most programming languages.

items.title: Awesome Zsh Plugins
items.content_text:
### Plugins / [superconsole](https://github.com/alexchmykhalo/superconsole) - Windows-only

*   [auto-venv (skylor0tang) (⭐6)](https://github.com/Skylor-Tang/auto-venv) - Automatically activates the Python virtual environment in the current directory or its parent directories.
*   [auto-venv (songlkkevin) (⭐0)](https://github.com/songlkkevin/zsh-auto-venv) - Automatically detect and activate the nearest Python virtual environment when changing directories.
*   [disk-guard (⭐1)](https://github.com/TomfromBerlin/Zsh-Disk-Guard) - Warns you when you try to copy/move/rsync files and are running low on local disk space, and provides useful information and a nice progress bar for `cp` and `mv`.
*   [git-graph (⭐0)](https://github.com/Maks0u/git-graph) - Adds a pretty `git` graph.
*   [rura (⭐0)](https://github.com/kiki-ki/rura) - A simple ZSH plugin to save and jump to directories.
*   [ssh-host (⭐1)](https://github.com/obolientsev/ssh-host) - Manage ssh with [fzf (⭐74k)](https://github.com/junegunn/fzf).

### Completions / [superconsole](https://github.com/alexchmykhalo/superconsole) - Windows-only

*   [python-module-completion (⭐3)](https://github.com/UshioA/zsh-python-module-completion) - Intelligent tab completion for python -m commands with hierarchical module navigation and smart project detection.

### Themes / [superconsole](https://github.com/alexchmykhalo/superconsole) - Windows-only

*   [quantum (⭐17)](https://github.com/calebephrem/quantum-zsh) - Sleek, dynamic Zsh theme built for speed, style, and shell supremacy. Whether you're deep in Git or just vibing in your terminal, Quantum adapts to your flow.
*   [r (⭐1)](https://github.com/rafalkaron/r-zsh-theme) - A simple yet informative ZSH theme.
